review.description: Pull request reviews, on machines enrolled with the review pool label

setup.command: if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then c=~/.cache/work/pnpm-store; s=~/.local/share/pnpm/store; o="$PWD/../.work-pnpm"; if [ -f "$c/.work-cache.json" ] && mkdir -p "$s" "$o/up" "$o/work" && { grep -qs " $s " /proc/mounts || mount -t overlay overlay -o "lowerdir=$c,upperdir=$o/up,workdir=$o/work" "$s" 2>/dev/null; }; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline --store-dir "$s"; else pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --store-dir "$c" || pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi; elif [ -f bun.lock ] || [ -f bun.lockb ]; then bun install --frozen-lockfile; elif [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; fi; for f in compose.yaml compose.yml docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yml; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then docker compose -f "$f" pull --ignore-buildable --ignore-pull-failures --quiet; break; fi; done

fill.command: if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm fetch --store-dir ~/.cache/work/pnpm-store; fi

github-poster.description: Posts reviews to GitHub from the control plane; no agent runs here
